notes.title: 😈 Your Soul... I Mean, Your Feedback is Needed! 🔥
notes.content:
[url=https://forms.office.com/e/nnSbRRMeA5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464722/6a8f373f6f01e50f08192f35d756b4ce8c4d8d4f.png[/img][/url]

Minions,

The Demon Inc. Playtest has been running for a few weeks now, and we are pleased with the strategic mischief and high-level scheming you’ve demonstrated so far. Your commitment to our expansion efforts has not gone unnoticed. 💼😈

But even the most sinister empires can improve! To ensure Demon Inc. reaches its full, world-dominating potential, we need your wicked insights. If you haven’t yet submitted your report, please do so via the official feedback form—your thoughts will help us craft an even more diabolical experience!

📝 Submit your performance review here: https://forms.office.com/e/nnSbRRMeA5

Your cooperation is, of course, highly encouraged (and definitely not being monitored by upper management). Keep up the hard work, and stay tuned for further corporate directives.

- The Demon Inc. Management

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283760/Demon_Inc/

notes.title: 🔥 The Demon Inc. Playtest is Now Live! 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464722/8429a0b70e78cd627521497aef64cd7b2fbb60b7.png[/img]


The time has come, mortals and mischief-makers—our Demon Inc. playtest is officially live on Steam! 👹💼

This early build is just a glimpse of what’s to come, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! Your feedback will help shape the future of the game, so dive in, experiment with different strategies, and let us know your thoughts.

🏹 What to Expect:
🔹 A first taste of Demon Inc.’s core mechanics
🔹 A lot of Cards, one biome, various bosses on 10 Stages and difficulty setups to test out
🔹 A chance to influence the game's development

💬 How to Share Feedback:
Your input is invaluable! Tell us what you loved, what felt off, and what you’d like to see improved. You can share your thoughts on:
📝 [url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=yYBTqqc7O0SWhSEb6-up96SBdOfb3HxJj5W53RKItcxUNTFZSEdEOFpCMjVWMEZDU0tUVUNLMEJYTy4u]Our feedback form[/url] 
💬 The Steam forum
💀 [url=https://discord.gg/Tp9MJyfv]Our Discord[/url] & socials

Your insights will help us create the best possible experience, so don’t hold back!

Thank you for playing, and welcome to Demon Inc.—now get to work! 🔥

Our Form (you can also access it through the game):
https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=yYBTqqc7O0SWhSEb6-up96SBdOfb3HxJj5W53RKItcxUNTFZSEdEOFpCMjVWMEZDU0tUVUNLMEJYTy4u

notes.title: Playtest incoming! Sign up now!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/eTguMCkW][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464722/4101f815a5ab3b5ef62a2ec31b28d01d628066d5.png[/img]
[/url]

Hello Steam Community! 🚀 First post here—exciting times! 😃

It’s been a few months since we started working on Demon Inc., and we’re beyond thrilled to finally share it with you!

Demon Inc. is a deck-building rogue-lite where you, a CEO from hell, must navigate the chaotic world of modern fantasy business. Hire employees, manage inventory, and wield powerful abilities to build the ultimate deck and dominate the competition!

One thing we’ve learned is that [b]the best games are built with the community[/b]—and that’s where you come in! We’re excited to announce an upcoming playtest for Demon Inc., and we’d love for you to be a part of it!

If you’d like to participate (and we sure hope you do! 😈), join our [url=https://discord.gg/eTguMCkW]Discord[/url]:
[url=https://discord.gg/eTguMCkW]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464722/142635f4e9348a37ccc5355255e62ece64aef38e.png[/img]
[/url]
and make sure to Wishlist & Follow Demon Inc. so you don’t miss the upcoming announcements and start of Playtest!

Stay tuned for more details, and let us know what you think! 🔥💼

Cheers,
Julian
Goon Squad
